intro.text: A quartermaster in the Alethi army in Urithiru.

items.text: Working from an office in Urithiru with a stout woman as his scribe, Vevidar handed over two large bags of uncut emeralds from the royal reserve that Kaladin had requisitioned to train Radiants and squires. Nervous about holding such wealth, he made sure the paperwork was stamped with Kaladin's captain's seal and was glad to see the gems go, until Kaladin said he would be checking them in and out daily.

appearance.text: A beefy man who rolls up his shirtsleeves.

personality.text: He follows procurement rules carefully but talks to Kaladin informally, and grows nervous around large sums of money.
